min_area.title: Minimum room area
min_area.why: Rooms below the minimum area cannot hold the furniture and circulation the use needs and may fail the habitable-room requirements.
min_area.remedy: Enlarge the room, merge it with an adjoining space, or change its designated use.

min_width.title: Minimum room width
min_width.why: A room that is too narrow is hard to furnish and use even when its area is adequate.
min_width.remedy: Widen the room by shifting a wall, or reshape it so the clear width meets the minimum.

corridor_width.title: Corridor minimum width
corridor_width.why: Narrow corridors restrict movement of people, stretchers and wheelchairs and slow evacuation in an emergency.
corridor_width.remedy: Widen the corridor, or relocate the walls or fixtures that pinch it.

staircase_width.title: Staircase minimum clear width
staircase_width.why: Stair width governs how quickly people can leave the building and whether two streams can pass.
staircase_width.remedy: Increase the flight width, or provide an additional or wider staircase.

adjacency_rules.title: Bedroom must have accessible toilet
adjacency_rules.why: A bedroom with no adjoining toilet or bath forces occupants to cross other spaces, which hurts privacy and accessibility.
adjacency_rules.remedy: Add a toilet or bath next to the bedroom, or connect it to an existing one with a door.

adjacency_rules.title: Kitchen must connect to living/dining
adjacency_rules.why: A kitchen cut off from the dining or living area makes serving and supervision awkward.
adjacency_rules.remedy: Provide a door or open passage between the kitchen and the dining or living space.

adjacency_rules.title: Staircase must be near fire exit / lobby
adjacency_rules.why: A staircase that does not open onto a lobby, corridor or fire tower may not give a protected route out of the building.
adjacency_rules.remedy: Relocate the staircase or add a lobby or protected passage connecting it to the exit route.

adjacency_rules.title: Reception must connect to corridor or lobby
adjacency_rules.why: Reception that is not reachable from circulation space is hard for visitors to find and reach.
adjacency_rules.remedy: Connect the reception to the nearest corridor or lobby.
